model: Broker FCFE capitalisation at cost of equity (bank-style, net debt held at zero, engine route), earnings retention for net-capital growth as the reinvestment charge, perpetual-bond distributions charged in the flow

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: terminal nominal growth for a mature SOE securities firm (China nominal GDP ~4% less fee compression and a capital-constrained balance sheet), bracketed by revenue 5yr CAGR 1.3% and ordinary-equity / BVPS 3yr CAGR 6.5%; base revenue path runs -12% (post-peak reset) -> +2% -> +4% -> 3%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS 3yr CAGR 16.2% and net income 15.2% vs equity 6.2% and revenue 5.7% (>30% apart): FY2022 was the cycle trough (EPS 0.86) and FY2025 a strong year (1.35), so the 3yr EPS CAGR is trough-to-peak cycle, not trend. 5yr figures (FY2020 -> FY2025: revenue 1.3%, EPS 5.0%, equity 5.5%) are the better trend read; FY2020 EPS is on the pre-rights-issue weighted share count. Equity CAGR is not used as the growth rate.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are null: a broker's reported FCF (OCF - capex) swings tens of billions with margin-loan, repo and trading-book balances (FY2021 -54.7bn, FY2022 +54.7bn, FY2025 -34.1bn). The relevant series is profit to ordinary shareholders: FY2021 11,073 (peak) -> FY2022 7,498 -> FY2023 8,192 -> FY2024 9,814 -> FY2025 11,735 -> H1 2026 10,312 (half year). Net investment gains were 23% of revenue in FY2021, 17% in FY2022, 28% in FY2025 and 47% in H1 2026.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 is the cyclical peak (PBT ~RMB20.7bn, 44% margin). FY2027 revenue resets -12% to ~RMB41bn as investment gains revert to RMB10-11bn; pre-tax margin 36-37%, retention glides from 45% to 33% of ordinary profit as the payout rises toward two-thirds; FCFE ~RMB6.8bn rising to ~RMB13bn by FY2036; terminal ordinary ROE ~9%, terminal P/B ~0.76x.
scenario_narratives.bull: The upcycle persists: FY2027 holds the FY2026E revenue, margin settles at 39%, balance sheet grows 4-5% on retained earnings and ROE ~11-12% clears the 11% cost of equity; FCFE ~RMB9.5bn rising to ~RMB16bn; terminal P/B ~1.1x.
scenario_narratives.bear: The rally reverses and consolidated rivals take share: FY2027 revenue -30% to ~RMB33bn, margin 28-32%, retention stays above half to defend the dividend, ROE ~6-7%; FCFE ~RMB3.4bn recovering to ~RMB6.5bn; terminal P/B ~0.5x.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A securities firm is worth the equity cash flow it can distribute after funding the growth of its own regulatory capital, discounted at the cost of equity; reported free cash flow is margin-loan and repo noise and net debt is zero by construction. For China Merchants Securities that flow is profit to ordinary shareholders (after income tax, NCI and perpetual-bond coupons) less the earnings retained to grow net capital with the balance sheet. The firm earns ~9-10% on ordinary equity across a cycle against an 11% cost of equity, so fair value sits at or a little below ordinary book (RMB14.46 / HKD 16.99 per share). The valuation is dated at a cyclical earnings peak - H1 2026 profit doubled on investment gains in a China equity rally - so FY2026E is the undiscounted base year and the first discounted year mean-reverts; the H share at ~0.76x ordinary book and ~9.6x trailing earnings already prices much of that reversion, which is why the weighted value lands close to the price. The dominant risk is not capital but the earnings cycle: each 5pt on FY2027 revenue is ~RMB0.4/share.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cycle: H1 2026 net investment gains RMB12.9bn (+213%) and A-share ADT RMB3.26tn (+99%) are a peak, not a run-rate; the bear case (revenue -30%, margin 28-29%) is the FY2022 trough repeated on a 16%-larger balance sheet with mark-to-market losses on the trading book.

Consolidation: Guotai Haitong (merged) and CICC (post Dongxing/Cinda) now outrank CMS on several league tables; share loss in underwriting and institutional business is in the bear case, and an M&A deal as acquirer paid in shares is a dilution the flat share count does not model.

Regulation: CSRC fee rules (mutual-fund sales fees, buy-side advisory shift), margin-trading and capital/risk-control requirements can compress fee economics and raise the retention charge; state-policy capital allocation as an SASAC-controlled SOE.

Perpetual capital: RMB19bn of perpetual subordinated bonds (+RMB4bn since FY2024) are charged at their ~3.5% coupon in the flow; deducting face instead (preferred-like treatment) would take a further HKD ~2.6/share off every scenario.
Tax: FY2022-24 effective tax of 5-7% relied on tax-exempt fund distributions and CGB interest; the model assumes ~15% as taxable trading gains dominate, each 5pt of tax rate being ~RMB0.6/share.

Currency and listing: RMB flows against an HKD quote (a 10% RMB move is a 10% move in HKD value; CNYHKD is at the top of its 52-week range); the H share trades at a ~47% discount to the A share; 10% H-share dividend withholding is not modelled.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (6099.HK) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 12.31-18.65 HKD. CNYHKD=X and 600999.SS from the same source (see fx_note).
data_sources.financials: core_metrics / 6099.HK_Metrics.csv (RMB millions) derived from the FY2018-FY2025 annual reports and H1 2024-H1 2026 interim reports (HKEX PDFs, pdftotext); H1 2026 interim income statement, balance sheet, EPS note (perpetual distributions) and net-capital disclosures read directly from research/6099.HK/Extracted/6099.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt; FY2025 dividend and perpetual-distribution lines from 6099.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt.
data_sources.qualitative: research/6099.HK/Reports/6099.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-24): competitive position vs CITIC / Guotai Haitong / CICC, consolidation risk, segment outlook, industry 2026 forecast and sell-side sentiment.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E total revenue, other income and gains (IFRS gross basis: fee and commission income + interest income + net investment gains + other), RMB m. H1 2026 actual 27,272 (+80.9% YoY, interim income statement) + H2 2026E ~19,700 (= H2 2025 actual 34,616 - 15,079 = 19,537, held ~flat: the H1 2026 rally lifted investment gains to 12,914 (47% of revenue) and this is NOT extrapolated into H2). FY2025 actual 34,616, FY2024 30,622, FY2023 30,020, FY2022 29,336, FY2021 40,342 (prior cycle peak). No Q3 2026 report is in the folder yet (due late Oct 2026); the first evidence that would move this anchor.
inputs.share_count_basis: 8,696,526,806 A + H ordinary shares at 30 Jun 2026 (interim line 4558; weighted average = period-end, EPS note line 10894; basic = diluted EPS). Unchanged since the 2020 rights issue (6,699.4m -> 8,696.5m). One class with identical economic rights, so the per-share value applies to the H share. Held FLAT: no options or convertibles; the employee stock ownership scheme buys shares in the market (interim lines 4641-4643), SBC-zero; ShareRepurchases nil since FY2019.
inputs.debt_cash_note: Securities firm: bonds payable, short-term debt instruments, repo obligations and borrowings (core_metrics total_debt RMB231.3bn at 30 Jun 2026; 215.1bn at FY2025) fund the margin-financing book (RMB152bn), the proprietary trading book and client-driven products - operating funding of a leveraged financial intermediary, not a claim to subtract from an equity flow. Cash (30.0bn own cash; 173.8bn incl. client balances) is working liquidity; accounts payable to brokerage clients (RMB155bn) are matched by segregated client deposits. Net debt is zero by construction on the FCFE route (house convention: 1788.HK, 2016.HK, 0998.HK) and nothing is bridged after the flows. Gross figures are retained in core_metrics for the reader.
inputs.fcf_note: last_fcf is FY2026E FCFE (dividend capacity), not reported OCF - capex: FY2026E PBT ~20,700 (H1 actual 13,024 + H2E ~7,700; H2 2025 was 8,392) x (1 - 17% tax) = NI ~17,200, less perpetual-bond distributions ~650 = ~16,550 to ORDINARY shareholders, less ~45% retained (~7,450) to grow net capital = ~9,100. reported_fcf is the FY2025 reported OCF - capex (-33,384 - 723 = -34,107); reported OCF swings from +55bn (FY2022) to -54bn (FY2021) and -33bn (FY2025) with margin-loan, repo and trading-book balances and is NOT an earnings proxy, so the owner-FCF identity (reported - SBC - interest income) is deliberately not applied on this route.
inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero: StockBasedComp 0 and EquityAwardTaxes 0 in every year FY2018-FY2025 (core_metrics); the employee stock ownership scheme is funded by market purchases and its cost sits inside staff costs (interim line 4641). Basic = diluted EPS (RMB1.19 H1 2026). House and street bases coincide; band_position is degenerate (band collapsed).
inputs.fx_note: fx_rate converts CNY (model; the Company reports in RMB) to HKD (H-share quote): CNYHKD=X 1.1747 at 2026-10-23T12:53Z, Yahoo Finance chart API (52-week range 1.0825-1.1755, so the RMB is at the strong end of its range; a 5% RMB reversal is a 5% HKD value move). Same direction as the 2016.HK and 0998.HK precedents (1.1724 on 2026-10-16). The Shanghai A share (600999.SS) closed at CNY 16.15 on 2026-10-23 = HKD 18.97, a ~47% A/H premium (normal for a mid-sized Chinese broker), so the dual listing is NOT a parity check. Per-share values are per ordinary share and apply equally to A and H; 10% H-share dividend withholding is not modelled.
inputs.fy0: FY2026E (year ending 2026-12-31, unreported: H1 2026 actual + H2 estimate)
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-23T08:08:08Z HKEX regular close (Friday); valuation dated Saturday 2026-10-24
inputs.capital_anchor: Parent-company net capital RMB87.1bn at 30 Jun 2026 (89.5bn at FY2025; 87.4bn FY2024); risk coverage ratio 228% (257% FY2025; 239% FY2024) vs 100% regulatory floor; capital leverage ratio 12.4% at Q1 2026 vs 8% floor. Capital is ample (unlike the thin-CET1 joint-stock banks), so the retention charge is about funding BALANCE-SHEET GROWTH (margin book +40% in FY2025 to RMB133bn, total assets +16% in H1 2026 to RMB871bn), not repairing a buffer.
inputs.ordinary_equity_anchor: Equity attributable to shareholders RMB144,785m at 30 Jun 2026 (interim balance sheet) less other equity instruments (perpetual subordinated bonds, interim note 45) RMB19,000m = ordinary equity RMB125,785m; BVPS RMB14.46 = HKD 16.99 at fx_rate. NCI RMB46m (negligible). At the current_price the H share trades at ~0.76x ordinary BVPS and ~9.6x FY2025 EPS (RMB1.35). Ordinary equity FY2020 90,737 -> FY2025 121,005 (5.9% CAGR, all retained earnings; no issuance since 2020).
inputs.perpetual_treatment: RMB19,000m of perpetual subordinated bonds (15,000 FY2018-24; +900 H1 2025, +1,100 H2 2025, +2,000 H1 2026) sit inside equity attributable to shareholders. They are charged in the FLOW, not the bridge: distributions (FY2025 RMB614.7m, FY2024 572.2m, H1 2026 312.5m; EPS note line 10887 deducts them before ordinary EPS) are part of the 'cash_tax_rate' deduction so EBIT x (1 - rate) = profit to ORDINARY shareholders. This is the 2016.HK treatment and the FCFE-consistent one: like debt interest, the ~3.3-3.8% coupon is a cost in the flow and the principal (perpetual, callable at par by the issuer, coupon reset every 5 years) is not deducted again. The alternative - deduct face in equity_bridge as preferred-like capital - would take a further RMB2.18/share (HKD 2.57) off every scenario; it overstates the claim because the coupon is far below the 11% cost of equity. Ordinary BVPS and P/B above are already ex-perpetual.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Single CNY cost of equity 11.0% in every scenario (risk charged once, through scenario weights, not the discount rate). Built in the flows' own currency: 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8% (ASSUMPTION, not fetched; the 10Y CGB has traded ~1.6-2.0% since 2025) + beta ~1.4 (Chinese brokers are high-beta to the CSI 300; earnings are 47% mark-to-market investment gains in H1 2026) x China ERP ~6.5% = ~10.9%, rounded to 11.0%. Sits between the house CNY bank rates (0998.HK CITIC Bank 10.5%, 2016.HK Zheshang 11.0%) and the HKD broker rate (1788.HK 11.5%, where the HKD risk-free is ~1.8pt higher): CMS is a top-8 SOE broker with a 228% risk coverage ratio and China Merchants Group backing (lower capital/governance risk than a small joint-stock bank) but far higher earnings cyclicality. Hurdle for entry price is the house 15%.
inputs.lease_treatment: IFRS 16 right-of-use depreciation (inside D&A, RMB907m FY2025 incl. ROU) and lease-liability interest (RMB11m H1 2026) sit inside operating expenses and so inside the pre-tax margin; lease liabilities RMB858m (FY2025) are immaterial. lease_cost_pct_path and da_pct_path are zero so nothing is charged twice; nothing is deducted as debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, inside the 'cash_tax_rate' deduction. The margin is calibrated to PROFIT BEFORE INCOME TAX (includes share of associates Bosera Funds / China Merchants Fund, RMB747m H1 2026, after their own tax) and the deduction covers income tax (FY2025 1,758 = 12.5% of PBT; H1 2026 2,396 = 18.4%; FY2022-24 5-7% on tax-exempt fund distributions and CGB interest - FY2024's 7.4% / RMB16m cash tax is NOT used as a base), NCI (FY2025 -31m; H1 2026 +4m; ~0%) and perpetual-bond distributions (FY2025 615 = 4.4% of PBT). FY2025 total = (14,076 - 11,735) / 14,076 = 16.6%; forward 19-21% because income tax normalises toward 15% as realised trading gains (taxable) replace exempt income, and the fixed coupon on a now-larger RMB19bn perpetual stack is a bigger share of a post-peak PBT.
inputs.notes: MODEL: securities broker / investment bank -> dcf-methods routing: financials (bank / deposit-taker row and the broker precedent 1788.HK) are valued on the equity flow at the cost of equity, net debt zero; NOT an owner-FCF DCF (reported OCF - capex is margin-loan / repo / trading-book noise: +54.7bn FY2022, +21.5bn FY2024, -34.1bn FY2025, -3.9bn H1 2026). First valuation of this ticker; no MEMORY.md entry. Run through the component engine with the bank mapping used for 2016.HK / 0998.HK / 1788.HK: revenue = total revenue, other income and gains; ebitda_margin = PRE-TAX margin (D&A, SBC, leases, working capital all zero so EBIT = PBT); cash_tax_rate = income tax + NCI + perpetual-bond distributions so EBIT x (1 - rate) = profit to ordinary shareholders; capex = EARNINGS RETAINED to grow net capital / the balance sheet (the broker's reinvestment), set so terminal retention x terminal ROE = terminal growth; FCF = FCFE = dividend capacity. The 15x terminal cap does not bind (Gordon 1.03/0.08 = 12.9x base). CYCLE: this valuation is dated at a cyclical EARNINGS PEAK. H1 2026 PBT 13,024 (+129% YoY) on net investment gains of 12,914 (+213%) during a China equity rally (A-share ADT RMB3.26tn, +99%; ChiNext +36%, STAR 50 +64%); FY2026E (fy0) is therefore NOT discounted and the first discounted flow (FY2027) mean-reverts: base revenue -12%, pre-tax margin 37% (vs 44% FY2026E, 40.7% FY2025, 34.3% FY2021-25 average). The FY2026E figure is an estimate; the FY2026 annual report (Mar 2027) replaces it. ROE: weighted average return on net assets FY2021 11.5%, FY2022 7.5%, FY2023 7.9%, FY2024 8.8%, FY2025 9.9%, H1 2026 8.2% (half-year, not annualised). Terminal ordinary ROE: base ~9%, bull ~11.7%, bear ~6.5%, all at or below the 11% cost of equity, so fair value sits at or below ordinary book: (ROE - g)/(CoE - g) = 0.76x base, 1.09x bull, 0.47x bear - the engine reproduces these independently. KEY FINDINGS: (1) The H share at ~0.76x ordinary book and ~9.6x trailing EPS already prices mean reversion; the weighted value is close to the price. (2) The dividend (~42-44% payout, RMB4.94bn FY2025) is covered ~1.5-2x by FCFE in base; the Board's interim policy caps the interim at 40% of NI. (3) The single largest swing is the FY2027 revenue reset: each 5pt on FY2027 growth is ~RMB0.4/share. (4) Industry consolidation (Guotai Haitong, CICC/Dongxing/Cinda) is a share-loss risk in the bear case and a possible M&A-as-acquirer dilution risk the flat share count does not model. Valuation date is ~10 months into FY2026, so the FY2025 final dividend paid in July 2026 belongs to fy0 and is not double-counted.

bear.growth_rationale: The rally reverses: investment gains fall to the FY2022-23 level (~RMB5-7bn) with mark-to-market losses on the enlarged trading book, ADT halves from the H1 2026 record, margin balances shrink; FY2027 revenue ~RMB32.9bn (the FY2022-24 trough band of 29-31bn plus a larger interest book), a further -3% in FY2028 as consolidated rivals (Guotai Haitong, enlarged CICC) take underwriting and institutional share, then 2-2.5% nominal.
bear.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin falls to the FY2022 trough (29.1%) and below as funding cost on a 16%-larger balance sheet, credit impairments on the RMB152bn margin / RMB21bn stock-pledge books and fee compression bite; partial recovery to 32% as costs are cut.
bear.capex_rationale: Retention held at ~55% of ordinary profit in FY2027 (12.6% of revenue at 29% margin x 79%) - the dividend is cut in RMB terms but the ~45% payout is defended - gliding to ~38% = terminal g 2.5% / terminal ordinary ROE ~6.6% (FY2022-23 trough ROE 7.5-7.9% on total attributable equity). Terminal P/B ~0.5x.
bear.tax_rationale: Income tax ~14% + fixed RMB690m perpetual coupon against a ~9.5bn PBT (~7%) = 21%.
bear.terminal_note: Gordon 1.025/0.085 = 12.1x FCFE; cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B ~0.5x.
bear.narrative: Rally reverses and consolidation bites: revenue falls 30% to the FY2022-24 trough band, margin 28-32%, ROE ~6-7% well below the cost of equity; fair value is about half of ordinary book.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 -12% to ~RMB41.4bn: net investment gains revert from the ~RMB20bn+ FY2026E run-rate toward RMB10-11bn (FY2024-25 level on a larger book), fee income eases from the H1 2026 ADT peak (~18bn annualised) to ~17bn, interest income grows with the RMB150bn+ margin book. Still +20% on FY2025 because ADT, margin balances and the trading book are structurally larger. Then +2% as the cycle settles, +4% through the mid-years (wealth-management AUM, buy-side advisory +85% YoY, custody 20.9% share, SOE-focused IB) fading to 3% nominal.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin: FY2021 34.0%, FY2022 29.1%, FY2023 31.0%, FY2024 36.6%, FY2025 40.7%, FY2026E ~44% (H1 47.8%). Base resets to 37% in FY2027 (staff-cost accruals fall with profit but the fixed cost base of 265 branches, ~RMB7.5bn funding cost and AI/technology spend remain) and holds 36-37%, above the FY2021-25 average of 34.3% because the mix has shifted toward higher-margin investment, custody and interest income and away from commission.
base.capex_rationale: Earnings retained to grow net capital and the balance sheet. FY2027 13.4% of revenue = 45% of ordinary profit (FY2024-25 actual retention 56-58%; FY2025 payout RMB4.94bn / 11,735 = 42%), gliding to 9.8% = 33% of ordinary profit = terminal g 3.0% / terminal ordinary ROE ~9.1%, i.e. payout rises to ~67% as CSRC dividend guidance and a slower-growing balance sheet free up capital. FY2027 FCFE ~RMB6.8bn vs a ~RMB5-7bn ordinary dividend.
base.tax_rationale: Income tax ~15% (between FY2025 12.5% and H1 2026 18.4%; FY2024's 7.4% excluded) + NCI ~0% + perpetual-bond distributions ~RMB690m on RMB19bn (~4.5% of a ~15.3bn PBT) = 19.5%, vs 16.6% actual FY2025. Held flat; the fixed coupon's share falls slightly as PBT grows (ignored, conservative).
base.terminal_note: Gordon on FY2036 FCFE at 11.0% - 3.0% = 12.9x; 15x cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B ~0.76x on ~9.1% ordinary ROE, consistent with (ROE - g)/(CoE - g).
base.narrative: Cycle normalises, franchise intact: revenue resets 12% below the FY2026 peak, pre-tax margin 36-37%, balance sheet grows 3-4% on retained earnings and the payout drifts up toward two-thirds. Terminal ROE ~9% against an 11% cost of equity.

bull.growth_rationale: The China capital-markets upcycle persists through FY2027 (industry forecast +25% revenue / +26% profit for 2026; insurance long-term equity pilots, mutual-fund reform, STAR/ChiNext IPO pipeline incl. CXMT), so FY2027 holds the FY2026E level, then 4-5% as wealth management and custody compound and CMS International grows off a ~3% base.
bull.margin_rationale: Operating leverage of a sustained upcycle: 42% in FY2027 (between FY2025 40.7% and FY2026E 44%), settling at 39%, the FY2024-25 average; AI-driven cost-to-serve gains offset fee compression.
bull.capex_rationale: Retention 40% of ordinary profit in FY2027 (13.6% of revenue at a 42% margin x 81%) gliding to 30% = terminal g 3.5% / terminal ordinary ROE ~11.7% (the FY2021 peak-cycle ROE sustained). Payout rises to 70%.
bull.tax_rationale: Income tax ~15.5% on a trading-gain-heavy mix + fixed perpetual coupon ~3.5% of a larger PBT.
bull.terminal_note: Gordon 1.035/0.075 = 13.8x FCFE; cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B ~1.1x.
bull.narrative: Upcycle holds: FY2027 matches the FY2026 peak, margin settles at 39%, ROE ~11-12% clears the cost of equity and the H share re-rates to book.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (above the 15% house default, below the 35-40% used for thin-capital Chinese banks): the valuation is struck at a cyclical earnings peak with 47% of H1 2026 revenue from mark-to-market investment gains, sell-side consensus is Hold/Sell with targets at or below the price, and state-directed consolidation has produced larger rivals; but capital is ample (risk coverage 228%, no raise needed) and the franchise (custody #1, ~22m clients, CMG backing) is intact, so solvency is not the bear case. Bull 20%: the China upcycle could run (industry 2026 profit +26% forecast, policy support via SFISF and Central Huijin), but sustaining a 44% margin requires the market to hold its gains. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
